about: Real Vercel AI SDK v7 spans as its official @ai-sdk/otel integration produces them (GenAI-native: invoke_agent, step, chat, execute_tool, embeddings, and decide, speech and transcription), the integration the rius SDK registers, with the option it passes (usage, without which the reasoning split is never written). Recorded through a scripted fetch (and a scripted WebSocket for realtime transcription) with an AsyncLocalStorage context manager and deterministic clocks: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. The rius SDK starts these spans through aggregatingTracer, which moves a run's total usage off its invoke_agent span; replay.aggregating_producer tells the expected-result tool to do the same.

scenarios.generate_text: generateText with a system prompt, temperature and maxOutputTokens.
scenarios.tool_loop: generateText with one tool and stopWhen: stepCountIs(2): two model calls (24/51 then 91/15 tokens) with the tool executed between them.
scenarios.embed: embed with text-embedding-3-small; the response vector is three floats.
scenarios.generate_object: generateObject with a JSON schema (deprecated in v7, still traced as its own operation).
scenarios.decide: experimental_decide with OpenAI's decision model (gpt-6-luna) and one boolean question: an operation span and its model-call span, both named decide; only the model call carries usage (30/2 tokens). @ai-sdk/otel writes the operation as decide, which the conventions do not define; normalization classifies both spans as LLM.
scenarios.generate_speech: generateSpeech with gpt-4o-mini-tts. One span, whose operation @ai-sdk/otel writes as the AI SDK's operation id (ai.generateSpeech): no convention names a speech operation. OpenAI's speech endpoint returns only the audio, so there is no usage. Normalization classifies it as LLM.
scenarios.transcribe: transcribe with gpt-4o-transcribe. One span, operation ai.transcribe. With the usage option the provider's usage is written whole as JSON (ai.response.usage), and its numbers are also written flattened under gen_ai.usage.* (input 14, output 8, total 22, and the audio/text input split). Normalization classifies it as LLM.
scenarios.stream_transcribe: experimental_streamTranscribe with gpt-realtime-whisper over OpenAI's realtime WebSocket (scripted): two audio chunks in, one delta and the completed transcript out. One span, operation ai.streamTranscribe, gen_ai.request.stream true, no usage. Normalization classifies it as LLM.
scenarios.image_file: generateText with a user message holding a file part: a 1x1 PNG as a Buffer, media type image/png.
scenarios.pdf_file: The same with a one-page PDF, application/pdf.
scenarios.text_plain_file: The same with a text/plain file. The chat-completions provider cannot send it and rejects the call; the spans, with the prompt, are still recorded.
scenarios.audio_file: The same with a WAV file, audio/wav.

vercel-ai-otel-7.0.137.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-19 twice in a row from the lockfile's node_modules (Node 24.2.0): byte-identical, and the earlier scenarios unchanged.
